changelog:
Initial release of scrapfly-sdk-go.

- Introduces Go SDK for web scraping with Scrapfly.
- Supports proxy rotation, anti-bot bypass, JavaScript rendering, screenshots, and AI extraction.
- Provides Go-idiomatic API with detailed configuration options.
- Includes examples for basic scraping, anti-bot bypass, geo-targeting, rendering, and data extraction.
- Features built-in goquery selector for easy HTML parsing.
